fullText.simplified:
大事

    曹操看完刘备的信，正在生气，看到手下那么着急地说“大事不好了”，就更不高兴了。
    “出了什么大事了？”曹操大声问道。
    “我们的河南被吕布拿走一大半了！”手下看到曹操生气，很害怕，但又不敢不说，所以说得很快。
      “什么？”曹操不敢相信。怎么可能？吕布一直是个没脑子的人，他怎么可能想到去打河南呢？曹操走上前，对那个手下说道：“你，你再说一次！”
      “河南，我们的老家河南，马上就被吕布拿走了！”这个手下看到曹操离自己那么近，更害怕了，但还是又说了一次。
    “真的是吕布！”曹操一下子坐在椅子上。他明白，这次问题大了。
    曹操马上找他的将军们来开会。大家听后都很吃惊，都不敢相信：吕布一直不太聪明，是谁为他想的这么好的办法呢？
    将军们你一句我一句，说了半天。曹操坐在上面一边听，一边想：现在军队的大米不多了。我们的大米都在河南老家。如果河南被吕布拿下，我们就没有大米了。那几天后我拿下徐州市，又有什么用？没有大米，军队那么多人吃什么？到了那个时候，我这么多年的努力，就都没了。
    曹操越想越害怕，一下子站了起来对将军们说：“马上回河南！”
    军队离开了徐州，往河南去了。曹操骑着马，走三步，回头看一眼徐州市，对自己说：“徐州，我还会再来的。”
fullText.traditional:
大事

    曹操看完劉備的信，正在生氣，看到手下那麼著急地說“大事不好了”，就更不高興了。
    “出了什麼大事了？”曹操大聲問道。
    “我們的河南被呂布拿走一大半了！”手下看到曹操生氣，很害怕，但又不敢不說，所以說得很快。
      “什麼？”曹操不敢相信。怎麼可能？呂布一直是個沒腦子的人，他怎麼可能想到去打河南呢？曹操走上前，對那個手下說道：“你，你再說一次！”
      “河南，我們的老家河南，馬上就被呂布拿走了！”這個手下看到曹操離自己那麼近，更害怕了，但還是又說了一次。
    “真的是呂布！”曹操一下子坐在椅子上。他明白，這次問題大了。
    曹操馬上找他的將軍們來開會。大家聽後都很吃驚，都不敢相信：呂布一直不太聰明，是誰為他想的這麼好的辦法呢？
    將軍們你一句我一句，說了半天。曹操坐在上面一邊聽，一邊想：現在軍隊的大米不多了。我們的大米都在河南老家。如果河南被呂布拿下，我們就沒有大米了。那幾天後我拿下徐州市，又有什麼用？沒有大米，軍隊那麼多人吃什麼？到了那個時候，我這麼多年的努力，就都沒了。
    曹操越想越害怕，一下子站了起來對將軍們說：“馬上回河南！”
    軍隊離開了徐州，往河南去了。曹操騎著馬，走三步，回頭看一眼徐州市，對自己說：“徐州，我還會再來的。”

sentences.pinyin: shǒu xià kàn dào cáo cāo shēng qì hěn hài pà
sentences.english: Seeing that Cao Cao was angry, the subordinate was very scared.

sentences.traditional: 但又不敢不說，所以說得很快。
sentences.pinyin: dàn yòu bù gǎn bù shuō suǒ yǐ shuō de hěn kuài
sentences.english: But he didn’t dare not say anything, so he spoke very quickly.

sentences.simplified: “什么？”曹操不敢相信。怎么可能？
sentences.traditional: “什麼？”曹操不敢相信。怎麼可能？
sentences.pinyin: shén me cáo cāo bù gǎn xiāng xìn zěn me kě néng
sentences.english: “What?” Cao Cao couldn’t believe it. How is that possible?

sentences.simplified: 吕布一直是个没脑子的人，他怎么可能想到去打河南呢？
sentences.traditional: 呂布一直是個沒腦子的人，他怎麼可能想到去打河南呢？
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù yì zhí shì ge méi nǎo zi de rén tā zěn me kě néng xiǎng dào qù dǎ hé nán ne
sentences.english: Lü Bu had always been empty-headed. How could he think of going to fight Henan?

sentences.simplified: 曹操走上前，对那个手下说道：“你，你再说一次！”
sentences.traditional: 曹操走上前，對那個手下說道：“你，你再說一次！”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo zǒu shàng qián duì nà ge shǒu xià shuō dào nǐ nǐ zài shuō yí cì
sentences.english: Cao Cao stepped forward and said to the subordinate, “Repeat that again!”

sentences.simplified: “河南，我们的老家河南，马上就被吕布拿走了！”
sentences.traditional: “河南，我們的老家河南，馬上就被呂布拿走了！”
sentences.pinyin: hé nán wǒ men de lǎo jiā hé nán mǎ shàng jiù bèi lǚ bù ná zǒu le
sentences.english: “Henan, our home region of Henan, will soon be taken by Lü Bu!”

sentences.simplified: 这个手下看到曹操离自己那么近，更害怕了，但还是又说了一次。
sentences.traditional: 這個手下看到曹操離自己那麼近，更害怕了，但還是又說了一次。
sentences.pinyin: zhè ge shǒu xià kàn dào cáo cāo lí zì jǐ nà me jìn gèng hài pà le dàn hái shi yòu shuō le yí cì
sentences.english: Seeing Cao Cao so close to him, the subordinate became even more scared, but he repeated it anyway.

sentences.simplified: “真的是吕布！”曹操一下子坐在椅子上。
sentences.traditional: “真的是呂布！”曹操一下子坐在椅子上。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de shì lǚ bù cáo cāo yí xià zi zuò zài yǐ zi shang
sentences.english: “It really is Lü Bu!” said Cao Cao, suddenly sitting down in his chair.

sentences.simplified: 他明白，这次问题大了。
sentences.traditional: 他明白，這次問題大了。
sentences.pinyin: tā míng bai zhè cì wèn tí dà le
sentences.english: He understood that there was a big problem this time.

sentences.simplified: 曹操马上找他的将军们来开会。
sentences.traditional: 曹操馬上找他的將軍們來開會。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo mǎ shàng zhǎo tā de jiāng jūn men lái kāi huì
sentences.english: Cao Cao immediately arranged a meeting with his generals.

sentences.simplified: 大家听后都很吃惊，都不敢相信：
sentences.traditional: 大家聽後都很吃驚，都不敢相信：
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā tīng hòu dōu hěn chī jīng dōu bù gǎn xiāng xìn
sentences.english: Everyone was shocked to hear this and couldn’t believe it:

sentences.simplified: 吕布一直不太聪明，是谁为他想的这么好的办法呢？
sentences.traditional: 呂布一直不太聰明，是誰為他想的這麼好的辦法呢？
sentences.pinyin: lǚ bù yì zhí bú tài cōng ming shì shéi wèi tā xiǎng de zhè me hǎo de bàn fǎ ne
sentences.english: Lü Bu had never been very smart, so who had come up with such a good idea for him?

sentences.simplified: 将军们你一句我一句，说了半天。
sentences.traditional: 將軍們你一句我一句，說了半天。
sentences.pinyin: jiāng jūn men nǐ yí jù wǒ yí jù shuō le bàn tiān
sentences.english: The generals each expressed their own views, and they spoke for a long time.

sentences.simplified: 曹操坐在上面一边听，一边想：现在军队的大米不多了。
sentences.traditional: 曹操坐在上面一邊聽，一邊想：現在軍隊的大米不多了。
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo zuò zài shàng miàn yì biān tīng yì biān xiǎng xiàn zài jūn duì de dà mǐ bù duō le
sentences.english: Cao Cao was seated, listening and thinking at the same time: the troops are running low on rice.

sentences.simplified: 我们的大米都在河南老家。如果河南被吕布拿下，我们就没有大米了。
sentences.traditional: 我們的大米都在河南老家。如果河南被呂布拿下，我們就沒有大米了。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ men de dà mǐ dōu zài hé nán lǎo jiā rú guǒ hé nán bèi lǚ bù ná xià wǒ men jiù méi yǒu dà mǐ le
sentences.english: All of our rice is in our home region of Henan. If Henan is taken by Lü Bu, we won’t have any rice.

sentences.simplified: 那几天后我拿下徐州市，又有什么用？
sentences.traditional: 那幾天後我拿下徐州市，又有什麼用？
sentences.pinyin: nà jǐ tiān hòu wǒ ná xià xú zhōu shì yòu yǒu shén me yòng
sentences.english: Then what’s the point of me taking Xuzhou in a few days?

sentences.simplified: 没有大米，军队那么多人吃什么？
sentences.traditional: 沒有大米，軍隊那麼多人吃什麼？
sentences.pinyin: méi yǒu dà mǐ jūn duì nà me duō rén chī shén me
sentences.english: I have so many troops; what will they eat if we don’t have any rice?

sentences.simplified: 到了那个时候，我这么多年的努力，就都没了。
sentences.traditional: 到了那個時候，我這麼多年的努力，就都沒了。
sentences.pinyin: dào le nà ge shí hou wǒ zhè me duō nián de nǔ lì jiù dōu méi le
sentences.english: At that point, all the years of work I’ve put in will be gone.

sentences.simplified: 曹操越想越害怕，
sentences.traditional: 曹操越想越害怕，
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo yuè xiǎng yuè hài pà
sentences.english: The more Cao Cao thought about it, the more scared he became.

sentences.simplified: 一下子站了起来对将军们说：“马上回河南！”
sentences.traditional: 一下子站了起來對將軍們說：“馬上回河南！”
sentences.pinyin: yí xià zi zhàn le qi lai duì jiāng jūn men shuō mǎ shàng huí hé nán
sentences.english: He quickly stood up and said to his generals, “Go back to Henan at once!”

sentences.simplified: 军队离开了徐州，往河南去了。
sentences.traditional: 軍隊離開了徐州，往河南去了。
sentences.pinyin: jūn duì lí kāi le xú zhōu wǎng hé nán qù le
sentences.english: The troops left Xuzhou and headed for Henan.

sentences.simplified: 曹操骑着马，走三步，回头看一眼徐州市，对自己说：“徐州，我还会再来的。”
sentences.traditional: 曹操騎著馬，走三步，回頭看一眼徐州市，對自己說：“徐州，我還會再來的。”
sentences.pinyin: cáo cāo qí zhe mǎ zǒu sān bù huí tóu kàn yì yǎn xú zhōu shì duì zì jǐ shuō xú zhōu wǒ hái huì zài lái de
sentences.english: Cao Cao mounted his horse, rode three steps, and, looking back at the city of Xuzhou, said to himself, “Xuzhou, I will be back.”

After reading Liu Bei’s letter, Cao Cao was angry, ..
.. and he was even more unhappy when he saw his subordinate say anxiously, “terrible news!”
“What happened?” Cao Cao asked in a big voice.
“Lü Bu has taken most of Henan!”
Seeing that Cao Cao was angry, the subordinate was very scared.
But he didn’t dare not say anything, so he spoke very quickly.
“What?” Cao Cao couldn’t believe it. How is that possible?
Lü Bu had always been empty-headed. How could he think of going to fight Henan?
Cao Cao stepped forward and said to the subordinate, “Repeat that again!”
“Henan, our home region of Henan, will soon be taken by Lü Bu!”
Seeing Cao Cao so close to him, the subordinate became even more scared, but he repeated it anyway.
“It really is Lü Bu!” said Cao Cao, suddenly sitting down in his chair.
He understood that there was a big problem this time.
Cao Cao immediately arranged a meeting with his generals.
Everyone was shocked to hear this and couldn’t believe it:
Lü Bu had never been very smart, so who had come up with such a good idea for him?
The generals each expressed their own views, and they spoke for a long time.
Cao Cao was seated, listening and thinking at the same time: the troops are running low on rice.
All of our rice is in our home region of Henan. If Henan is taken by Lü Bu, we won’t have any rice.
Then what’s the point of me taking Xuzhou in a few days?
I have so many troops; what will they eat if we don’t have any rice?
At that point, all the years of work I’ve put in will be gone.
The more Cao Cao thought about it, the more scared he became.
He quickly stood up and said to his generals, “Go back to Henan at once!”
The troops left Xuzhou and headed for Henan.
Cao Cao mounted his horse, rode three steps, and, looking back at the city of Xuzhou, said to himself, “Xuzhou, I will be back.”
